run_ANETdetection_evaluate: run ANETdetection with ground truth and prediction JSON files to compute mAP for temporal action detection
build_ANETdetection_evaluation: build an ActivityNet detection evaluator that computes interpolated mean average precision across tiou thresholds
test_compute_average_precision_detection: test compute_average_precision_detection with ground truth and prediction DataFrames to get average precision scores
review_ANETdetection_import_ground_truth: review ANETdetection._import_ground_truth to parse a JSON ground truth file into a pandas DataFrame with activity index
refactor_compute_average_precision_detec: refactor compute_average_precision_detection to customize tiou thresholds or add logging for true positive and false positive assignment
